operations.title: WP7: the pi/8 fitted-phase clustering survives support-orbit collapse and prior changes, and decomposes as exact angle inheritance at fixed physics — fiber loop phases equal the fitted CKM angles alpha, beta, gamma to sub-milliradian at the global best-fit point, while the loop phase is multi-valued over that point (18 distinct folded phases across 14 orbits; two within orbit 4 alone), so it is not even a stratum function of the physics

evidence.paraphrase: 14/18 nine-link support orbits admit viable 3-sigma fits; orbits 1,3,8,12 fail with best chi2 3.8e3-4.9e3, dominated by 2-3 structurally mismatched CKM observables
best branch per orbit: all 14 within 0.04 rad of a pi/8 multiple; on-lattice 14/14 at delta=0.05 vs 0.25 uniform null; robust under uniform-over-fits, orbit-collapsed, and chi2-weighted priors

operations.outcome: Supports: the pi/8 clustering survives support-orbit collapse and prior reweighting in the rebuilt nine-link stratum; viability is not generic (4/18 orbits structurally inviable within budget)

evidence.paraphrase: 61 minima from all 14 fitted orbits agree on all 17 observables to <1e-4 sigma (one physical point) yet realize 18 distinct folded loop phases; cluster cores equal fitted beta, gamma, alpha to 4e-4, 6e-4, 5e-4 rad; arg det(YuYd) takes values in {0, ±phi, ±(pi-phi), pi} across the fiber

operations.outcome: Supports with refinement: at a fixed physical point the loop phase is multi-valued across and within orbits (not a stratum function of the physics), and its realized values equal the measured unitarity-triangle angles — the pi/8 clustering is angle inheritance, not presentation selection
